item.title: Manage an HStore Cluster with Hubble
item.description:
This guide highlights the key differences between HStore + PD distributed deployments and standalone RocksDB. For general graph modeling, data import, and query workflows, see the Hubble standalone guide. Content aligns with the Toolchain, Server, PD, and Store master branches (all currently 1.8.0).

The main repository’s docker/docker-compose-hstore.yml provides complete orchestration for PD, Store, Server, and Hubble. Follow the adjacent Docker README to prepare .env and generate the local Hubble configuration, then launch services from docker/ without maintaining separate Compose files. The guidance below focuses on connectivity and operations; ensure prerequisite credentials and service readiness from the README are met. Docker latest is a moving tag. Screenshots assist in UI navigation; verify deployed versions via image digests and build details. Metrics and permission APIs vary by version.
